interpretation.twoHoverPatterns: TapNow uses TWO different hover implementations: (1) toolbar group uses Tailwind `group-hover:opacity-100` on a child overlay SPAN with 200ms transition (2) chat input bar buttons use direct `hover:bg-*` on the BUTTON itself with no transition (instant).
interpretation.noScaleTransform: No hover state uses `transform: scale()`. Hover is purely color/opacity change — a calm, professional interaction.
interpretation.durationEvidence: 200ms is a standard 'fast but noticeable' duration. The `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` is Material's standard easing.
interpretation.cssFramework: Tailwind CSS class names visible (`absolute -inset-0.5 rounded-[10px] opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 group-hover:opacity-100`) — TapNow uses Tailwind + custom oklab() color space.
interpretation.designCohesion: Toolbar group (left) is visually lighter; chat bar (right) has stronger hover for emphasis. This is intentional design — tool buttons are frequently used so light hover; chat action buttons are click-decisions so stronger feedback.
